addressed.claim_id: Duplicate ids rejected with ValueError before adding to seen set
Amount cent-exactness check uses localcontext with operand-sized precision and maps decimal errors to ValueError
Date format check uses ASCII-only [0-9] pattern with fullmatch

Fixed amount validation to determine multiple-of-cent from Decimal tuple (exponent/trailing zeros) instead of low-precision quantize, so large scientific-notation values like 1E+27 validate correctly.
Fixed Phase 1 equality and Phase 2 subset sums to use exact integer cents derived from Decimal tuple instead of default-context Decimal addition, avoiding rounding/missed matches.
